title: Interfaces for admissible topos, spectral and completion data
statement: For an ideal I in a commutative ring A, use the closed-fibre and coefficient conventions of [def-per-admissible-modification-coefficient-data]. Define AdmissibleToposPresentation I C τ to consist of cofilteredness and thinness of the actual modification category, a coherent AdmissibleLimitSite I C τ whose cone is a two-dimensional limit, and conservativity of its compatible geometric points. Define AdmissibleFilteredAbutmentMap to be a map of the finite abutment filtrations with commuting inclusions, successor squares and associated graded maps identified with the stable-page map. Define AdmissibleSpectralPresentation P j to specify the actual coefficient diagram and exchange transitions, colimit cocones in the functor category, a sheaf-functorial E₂ cohomological spectral sequence whose E₂ terms are higher global sections of those coefficients, and for torsion input its cohomological abutment, graded identifications and natural filtered maps. Define AdmissibleCompletionComparison I P P' j j' to specify extension of centres with final opposite, blowup maps over the completion map, compatible closed-fibre isomorphisms and open squares, and site-projection comparisons. Its coefficientMap is the existing local derived exchange followed by the inverse-image transport along that site comparison. These are the identical interfaces formerly defined in the cohomology-presentation module; only their module location changes.
